name: experience-ablation-m8-live-shadow-readout
title: Experience-ablation M8: exploratory live shadow readout report
description: Milestone M8 of docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md. Build a committed report tool (experiments/experience-ablation/live-readout.mjs + selfcheck) that composes the EXISTING live observational substrate with the controlled pilot evidence and emits the M8 report artifact under the experiment evidence root: (a) live side — consume the existing read-only learning_effectiveness readout (per-story hint predictive value + ON/OFF arm comparison from recorded experience_hint_surfaced hintMode events; the existing resolveHintMode per-story assignment is reused as-is, no second live assignment system is built); (b) controlled side — read the expabl-m6-pilot-v1 score-records.jsonl, n-freeze.json and m7-decision.json; (c) emit live-readout.json + live-readout.md that STRICTLY separate the live exploratory results from the controlled causal results, label every live figure exploratory-only/non-inferential per plan sections 5.2 and 15, and carry the no-overclaim language including the skip_powered_study decision context. Exit criteria (plan section 13 M8 row): report separates live exploratory results from controlled causal results; no second live assignment system exists.
